messages:
maya (CS): SierraBank just uploaded a SIG/CAIQ and flagged two blockers: they need HSM attestation + sample audit logs by Fri EOD. They tried the export endpoint and are getting 401s when pulling the sig/export bundle. Can we triage?

sophia (Solutions): Copying the customer request here. Do we have the customer org_id and region? Also: is this the standard sig export flow or a bespoke field?

maya (CS): org_id: sbk-1023, region: eu-west-1. They used the Console export button and the API route /v1/exports/sig. They attached a job id: export-job-2026-03-14-9. I can ask them for logs if helpful.

liam (Eng): If they're seeing 401 from the export endpoint that's usually a token scope issue or the service account is missing the export role. Ask for the request-id header from the failed response and the time. Also send the curl they ran.

sierrabank-prod: hi — attaching the curl we ran:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports/sig?org=sbk-1023 -v
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-request-id: f8a3c2b1d4
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2026 09:12:03 GMT

liam (Eng): thanks. That request-id matches an auth rejection on our edge. @deploy-bot can you pull the auth log for x-request-id f8a3c2b1d4?

deploy-bot: export job failed: export-job-2026-03-14-9, error=401, x-request-id=f8a3c2b1d4, auth_err=token_missing_scope, backend=authn, region=eu-west-1

tom (Security): Important: customer also asked for HSM attestation docs. We need to confirm whether their plan includes HSM-backed key material and whether we have an export attestation artifact to share. If keys are customer-managed in KMS, we'll need to coordinate with infra to produce key rotation/usage logs.

sophia (Solutions): @maya can you confirm whether SierraBank uses Redwood-managed keys or their own KMS? The CAIQ asks for key custody info. If it's Redwood-managed HSM, legal will need the attestation PDF. If customer-managed, we provide the steps/logs they requested.

maya (CS): Customer says they configured dedicated VPC and selected "Redwood-managed KMS" during onboarding. They need attestation + sample audit logs from the last 90 days.

liam (Eng): Given deploy-bot notes token_missing_scope, quick repro: ask customer to run with an org-level service token with scope:exports:read. Example:
```
# generate temp token (console) -> TOKEN_TMP
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_TMP" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports/sig?org=sbk-1023
```
If that succeeds, we'll know it's scope related. If it fails with 401 but different auth_err, escalate.

sierrabank-prod: we can try that. can you confirm where to create an org-level token? we only see user tokens.

sophia (Solutions): In Console: Settings -> API tokens -> Create service token -> scope: exports:read, exports:write. Share back the job id if you retry.

ana? sorry typo

ana? not a participant; correcting

ana?? (typo)

ana editing message...

ana -> actually message by ana (CS Manager): If we can't get them attestation/logs by EOD Fri, ask for a 48h extension from SierraBank. I'll own escalation to enterprise account exec. Also copying Legal (@mike) for attestation sign-off.

mike (Legal): I'll review the HSM attestation template. If it's Redwood-managed, we typically have a notarized attestation PDF. Give me the HSM provider (e.g., AWS CloudHSM vs. HSM appliance) and the period they want covered. I'll check 3rd-party attestation availability.

tom (Security): @liam can infra produce the key usage audit slice for sbk-1023 last 90 days? We need: KMS:key_id, operation timestamps, calling principal, and request IDs. Mark anything redacted.

liam (Eng): I'll open infra ticket with request: PROD-AUDIT-#4678. ETA 24 hours for preliminary sample export. For the 401: I suspect the token was a personal token without org scopes. If customer can't create a service token, we can repro by generating a short-lived one and sharing instructions.

sierrabank-prod: we attempted service token and now got 200 and a download URL — thanks. But they also asked for HSM attestation PDF — can we deliver that and sample logs in the same bundle?

sophia (Solutions): We'll provide attestation PDF separately (Legal sign-off) and sample audit logs zipped. Attestation is signed by our compliance team; timeline depends on legal sign-off.

maya (CS): Customer requested: 1) confirm export delta (which fields included) 2) attestation PDF 3) sample logs for last 90 days 4) confirmation that export process does not include plaintext key material.

liam (Eng): Confirming: export bundle includes metadata, timestamps, principal IDs, and request IDs — it does NOT include key material or plaintext secrets. I'll add that to the response.

mike (Legal): I'll aim to review attestation draft by EOD tomorrow. @tom please DM me the HSM provider + cert chain info.

ana (typo earlier) -> ana (CS Manager): Great. I'll ask SBK for a 48h extension on the CAIQ due date and set expectation that attestation + logs will be delivered in that window.

maya (CS): SierraBank — we'll follow up after infra & legal confirm. For now, export 200 ok, please share the successful job id so we can attach logs to ticket. :thumbsup:

sierrabank-prod: success job id: export-job-2026-03-14-9-retry. keeping extension request on standby. thanks everyone.

liam (Eng): I'll attach auth trace and sample audit slice to PROD-AUDIT-#4678 and link back here when ready.

mike (Legal): noted. looping compliance.

thread closed: pending infra/legal deliverables.
